references.title: Early DHA/​ARA supplementation in growth-restricted very preterm infants: a randomized clinical trial

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Early DHA/​ARA supplementation in growth-restricted very preterm infants: a randomized clinical trial

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Inclusion criteria

Infants:

  • Gestational ages between 22 0/7 - 32 6/7 weeks gestation
  • < 25th centile birthweight

Exclusion criteria

  • Major congenital/chromosomal anomalies
  • Terminal illness in which decisions to withhold or limit support have been made

Estimated enrollment: 152

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Intervention

A DHA/ARA supplement will be added to expressed human milk or donor human milk administered during the first 3 weeks after birth.

Control

No intervention

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value: Growth (Head circumference at 36 weeks' postmenstrual age or discharge, Fat mass z-score), serum metabolic profile, cognitive outcomes
